headline: KISS OF LIFE drop first winter single 'Greedy' Nov 25
sub: The 'Sticky' summer queens try a warm, cozy winter sound
source: Source: S2 Entertainment via Korean media
caption:
KISS OF LIFE are back with their first-ever winter song, 'Greedy', on Nov 25 at 6 PM KST!

After summer hits like 'Sticky' and 'SWEAT', the group is showing a softer side with a warm, cozy sound for the season. A 'KIOF IS COMING TO TOWN' teaser and a vintage-animation concept video are already out on their official channels.

📌 Source: S2 Entertainment, via Korean media (Star News, Sports Kyunghyang)
